method: Binary presence of words, adjacent word pairs, and first word; shallow Gini decision trees; training-only vocabulary min document frequency 5; depths 1..4 and min_leaf 10 or 20; choose fewest nodes within 1 percentage point of best validation accuracy; no refit after selection.
split_method: Greedy allocation of shuffled connected groups of duplicate normalized messages across all five k settings toward 60/20/20; no labels used for allocation.
qualification: Internal grouped holdout of previously inspected final outputs. Neither a fresh independent corpus nor proof that the trained receiver uses these particular features. All-data accuracy is descriptive and includes fit/selection rows.
